metadata.title: New Lattices with Unexpected Shallow Deep Holes
metadata.abstract: Among lattices normalized to have packing radius one, the known shallowest depths of the deep holes in $7$-, $8$-, $9$- and $10$-dimensional lattices are $\sqrt{7/3}$, $\sqrt2$, $\sqrt{5/2}$ and $\sqrt{8/3}$, given by $E_7^*$, $E_8$, the laminated lattices $\Lambda_9$ and $\Lambda_{10}$, respectively. This paper presents new lattices in these dimensions with shallower deep holes. It also answers two problems of J. Martinet about short representatives of the classes of $\Lambda/2\Lambda$ in $7,8,9,10$ and $12$ dimensions.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 在填充半径归一为一时，构造七至十维中最深空穴更浅的新格，并处理若干商格短代表问题。
analysis.breakthrough: 改进若干维数的已知深洞深度记录，并回答 Martinet 问题。
analysis.limitations: 摘要称优于既有记录，不主张这些新格达到全局最优。 本条依据官方摘要整理，尚未核验正文证明；AI 披露以独立全文核查为准。
analysis.priorityReason: 改进若干维数的已知深洞深度记录，并回答 Martinet 问题。
